d54568vv.baseName: Walplus 78 x 120 cm LED Christmas Cone Tree Display - Blue Lights
d54568vv.variantName: Walplus 78 x 120 cm LED Christmas Cone Tree Display - Blue Lights
d54568vv.sourceDescription: This Christmas cone tree is specifically designed for decorating your Christmas tree and will create just the right atmosphere for your Christmas. The lights consist of 160 high-powered LEDs, which are very energy efficient and emit a bright light. Designed with 8 different lighting effects: a combination of all the effects, slow-glow, twinkle/flash, in wave, chasing/running water, sequential, steady on and slow fade, it beautifully lights up and creates a magical holiday atmosphere. It will be a real eye-catcher, especially in the evening, and also serves as a cosy source of ambient light. The free-standing cone tree can be easily and securely fixed to the ground with included mounting materials. Note: The included USB is not waterproof so this part has to avoid the water, but thanks to the 5 m cable the tree can be used outdoors as the cable and product are waterproof. The product has a USB connector, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Product Specifications Light colour: Blue Material: Metal Dimensions: 78 x 120 cm (Diameter x H) Voltage: DC 5 V Power: 5 W With 160 high-powered LEDs With 5 m extension cable A USB is included Suitable for indoor and sheltered outdoor use This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

mnq3qva0.baseName: My Christmas Heavy Duty Tree Stand with Foot Pedal 2.7L Water
mnq3qva0.variantName: My Christmas Heavy Duty Tree Stand with Foot Pedal 2.7L Water
mnq3qva0.sourceDescription: Designed for real Christmas trees up to 7 ft (2.2 m) tall, this Christmas tree stand provides a stable and secure base for indoor or outdoor use. The metal cable system and foot pedal make installation quick and easy, allowing the tree to be secured by one person. Made from durable ABS plastic and metal cable, the stand features a 2.7 litre water reservoir to help keep the tree hydrated throughout the festive season. To install, press the foot pedal switch to open the metal cable loop, insert the tree trunk, then operate the pedal until the cable loop securely grips the trunk. The dark green finish complements Christmas trees and festive decorations. Specifications Suitable for real Christmas trees up to 7 ft (2.2 m) tall, suitable for trunk diameters from 3–13 cm, material: ABS plastic and metal cable, water reservoir capacity: 2.7 litres, foot pedal operation, suitable for indoor and outdoor use, reusable design, and colour: dark green. Dimensions: Height: 2.2 m maximum tree height. Trunk diameter: 3 to 13 cm Read the operating instructions before use. Vivo Technologies Limited, Unit 11, Rainsford Road, London, NW10 7RG

MH Star UK Ltd, 1 Northampton Cross Logistics Park, Northampton Cross Road, Northampton, NN4 9FH, United Kingdom
